title: Daily Devotional #41
paragraphs: As I read Mark 13 today, I am struck by the words of Jesus regarding the end times. He tells us to be watchful and prepared, for we do not know the day or the hour when you will come again. This reminder is both sobering and comforting, for it reminds us of the importance of living each day with purpose and intention.

Jesus also warns us of the false prophets and the signs and wonders they will perform in order to deceive us. He tells us not to be misled by these things, but to hold fast to the truth of your Word. This is a reminder to me that I must always seek your guidance and discernment when faced with difficult decisions or when confronted with false teachings.

In this chapter, Jesus also speaks of the destruction of the temple and the tribulations that will come before his return. While these things may seem frightening, they are also a reminder that you are in control and that your plan will ultimately be fulfilled. I must trust in your plan, even when I don't understand it.

Finally, Jesus encourages us to be faithful and to endure to the end. This is a reminder that my faith must be steadfast, even in the face of trials and tribulations. I must rely on your strength and your grace to persevere through difficult times and to remain faithful to you.

Lord, I pray that you would help me to live each day with purpose and intention, seeking your will in all things. Help me to discern truth from falsehood and to remain faithful to you, no matter what may come. Thank you for your love and your grace, which sustain me always.
